title: Pure Helios
summary: Professor Banner's alchemical banish strategy built around Helios - The Primordial Sun, Macro Cosmos, and Chaos Distill, paired with Gren Maju Da Eiza and Eater of Millions. Banishing cards from both players' GYs, Decks, and Extra Decks scales the Helios line, Golden Homunculus, and Gren Maju to game-ending ATK.

summary.title: Starters
points: Chaos Distill banishes any card sent to your GY while face-up, searches Macro Cosmos or Grand Convergence from the Deck, and banishes itself while Macro Cosmos is active to search any Helios monster.
Macro Cosmos banishes every card sent to the GY and immediately Special Summons Helios - The Primordial Sun from your hand or Deck upon resolution.
Trap Trick banishes 1 Macro Cosmos from your Deck to Set a second copy directly to your field, ready to activate the same turn.

summary.title: Opening: Chaos Distill + Pot of Desires
steps: Activate Chaos Distill and use its effect to add Macro Cosmos from your Deck to your hand.
Activate Pot of Desires to banish 10 cards face-down and draw 2 cards, then Set Macro Cosmos (or Normal Summon Golden Homunculus / Gren Maju Da Eiza).
Flip Macro Cosmos to Special Summon Helios - The Primordial Sun from the Deck; on the next turn, banish Chaos Distill to search Helios Duo Megistus or Grand Convergence.

summary.title: Bosses & Banish Payoff
points: Helios - The Primordial Sun gains 100 ATK/DEF per banished monster and Tributes into Helios Duo Megistus (200 ATK/DEF per banished monster, revives with +300 ATK/DEF after battle destruction), which in turn Tributes into Helios Trice Megistus (300 ATK/DEF per banished monster, double attacker, revives with +500 ATK/DEF).
Golden Homunculus (1500 base + 300 ATK/DEF per banished card) and Gren Maju Da Eiza (400 ATK/DEF per banished card) gain +3000 and +4000 ATK immediately from a single Pot of Desires.
Eater of Millions banishes 5 to 15 Extra Deck cards face-down to summon itself, fueling your ATK scalers while banishing any monster it battles.
Two Level 4 Helios - The Primordial Sun overlay into Infernal Flame Banshee, which searches any Pyro Helios monster and revives itself when banished while you control a Pyro.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Grand Convergence is a Quick-Play Spell searchable by Chaos Distill that inflicts 300 damage and destroys all monsters on the field while you control Macro Cosmos.
Dimensional Fissure acts as additional copies of Macro Cosmos by banishing all monsters sent to the GY.

allow.Gren Maju Da Eiza: Level 3 FIRE Fiend companion that gains 400 ATK/DEF for each of your banished cards alongside Helios and Golden Homunculus.
allow.Eater of Millions: Banishes 5+ cards face-down from your Extra Deck to Special Summon itself, instantly adding ATK to Helios, Golden Homunculus, and Gren Maju while banishing any monster it battles.
allow.Pot of Desires: Banishes 10 cards from the top of your Deck face-down to draw 2 cards, immediately giving Golden Homunculus and Helios Trice Megistus +3000 ATK and Gren Maju +4000 ATK!
allow.Dimensional Fissure: Continuous Spell that acts as copies 7-9 of Macro Cosmos by banishing any monster sent to the GY.
allow.Trap Trick: Banishes 1 Macro Cosmos from your Deck to Set a 2nd Macro Cosmos directly to your field that can be activated the same turn to summon Helios - The Primordial Sun!
allow.Infernal Flame Banshee: Rank 4 Pyro Xyz that can be summoned using two Level 4 Helios - The Primordial Sun to search another Helios Pyro monster, and revives itself when banished while you control a Pyro monster.
